# fw train

> Reference of the fw train command: LoRA SGD demo on a synthetic 32-dim layer; a dataset.jsonl is validated and counted, not trained on; writes an fw-lora-v1…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/train/

LoRA SGD demo on a synthetic 32-dim layer; a dataset.jsonl is validated and counted, not trained on; writes an fw-lora-v1 JSON

## Usage

```bash
fw train [dataset.jsonl] [--rank 8] [--alpha 16] [--steps 60] [--out <file>]
```

## Aliases

`fw finetune` runs `fw train`. `fw lora` runs `fw train`.

## Flags

| Flag | Argument |
|---|---|
| `--rank` | `8` |
| `--alpha` | `16` |
| `--steps` | `60` |
| `--out` | `<file>` |

Every command also accepts `-C`, `--directory`, `--offline`, `--json`, `-q` and `-v`. See the [overview](/cli/).
